biography: Isac Yang didn't come from money or motorsport pedigree. Growing up in the favelas of São Paulo, his first taste of speed was dodging traffic on a battered scooter, delivering pizzas to help his family. He noticed a local karting track offering free sessions to underprivileged kids, and he was instantly hooked. His raw talent was undeniable, a whirlwind of aggressive overtakes and fearless braking. He scraped together funding through local businesses and relentless determination, moving up the ranks. A defining moment came in the Brazilian Formula Regional series, where he won the championship after starting the final race in last place due to a mechanical issue. Now, at 29, he's a midfield contender in the F.Inter MG-15 team, fighting tooth and nail for every point, proving that talent can bloom even in the most unlikely places. Though his equipment might not be top-tier, his heart and hustle are unmatched. He is determined to prove he belongs among the racing elite.
drivingStyle: Yang's driving style is all-out attack. He's known for late braking, aggressive corner entries, and a willingness to take risks that others wouldn't. He sometimes pushes his tires too hard early in a stint, but his sheer pace can make up for it. He thrives under pressure, often pulling off stunning overtakes in the closing laps. His tire management has improved over the years, but his aggressive nature still leads to occasional lock-ups and costly mistakes. His raw speed and never-say-die attitude make him a formidable opponent, especially on street circuits and in wet conditions.

careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Formula Regional Championship in 2020, after starting the final race last due to a mechanical failure and overtaking the entire field to take the victory on the last lap.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the Monaco Grand Prix in 2023, costing him a potential first victory in the F.Inter series. The incident was caused by a rare misjudgment of his braking point, and he publicly took full responsibility.
